contradictions: In silico predictions of missense mutation effects on protein stability (FoldX) did not always match observed protein abundance.
Mutations p.Pro359Thr (WASP) and p.Arg525Gln (BTK) were falsely predicted to result in protein loss by structural prediction but observed data contradicted that prediction.
Mutations p.Gly220Ser (perforin), p.Met63Lys (AP3B1), and p.Arg211His (ADA) were predicted to destabilize proteins but the proteins showed no loss of abundance in experiments.
FoldX predicted destabilization for p.Pro359Thr (WASP) and p.Arg525Gln (BTK) but these were falsely predicted to result in protein loss (false positives).
